rationale: Xiaoan is building spatial computing and AR/AI systems that require direct manipulation interfaces on smart glasses, while Priyanshu is an AI/ML engineer at Microsoft with expertise in neural networks and ML infrastructure—exactly the kind of technical depth needed to power context-aware AI systems for wearable devices. Both are based in Seattle and working at the intersection of AI and hardware, making this a strong pairing for exploring how to bring intelligent perception to ambient computing interfaces.
intro_message: Xiaoan (Sean) Liu, meet Priyanshu Mahey — Priyanshu's ML infrastructure and neural network expertise at Microsoft could be valuable as you scale the AI backbone for your spatial computing and AR/AI systems on smart glasses.
